name: Turkey

fees.name: Turkey e-Visa (evisa.gov.tr)
fees.validity: Typically 180 days from issue, single or multiple entry depending on nationality; stay length varies by nationality (commonly up to 30 or 90 days)
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (varies by country of travel document)
fees.notes: Official portal states the fee 'varies according to country of travel document and type of travel document' and is only revealed after selecting nationality in the application form - no published flat rate or public price list exists. Third-party sources report a wide range (approx. USD 20-96 depending on nationality; e.g. ~USD 43 commonly cited for Indian passport holders) but these are NOT confirmed on an official government page, so amount is left null. Do not treat third-party figures as authoritative.

fees.name: Sticker (consular) tourist visa - non-e-visa eligible nationalities
fees.applies: nationalities not eligible for e-visa or visa-free entry, applying via consulate/VFS (example schedule shown was for Czech Republic applicants)
fees.notes: Base adult visa fee shown on a VFS Global country-specific 'visa fees at a glance' page (Czech Republic applicants): EUR 80 for adults, EUR 40 for children aged 6-12, free under 6, EUR 35 for certain reduced-fee nationalities (e.g. Albania, Bosnia-Herzegovina, North Macedonia). Consular visa fees are reciprocity-based and vary by applicant nationality and VFS jurisdiction - this is an illustrative example, not a universal rate. No single global official price list was found; the Turkish MFA directs applicants to a fee PDF that could not be verified as current (the fetched copy was dated 2014 and is outdated).

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: MFA confirms transit visa requirements exist for certain nationalities but does not publish a specific fee amount on the general information page; no current official fee schedule could be located.

reciprocity_variations.note: Multiple third-party visa-agency sites (not official sources) commonly cite approx. USD 43 for Indian e-visa applicants in 2026, but this could not be confirmed on an official government page - amount left null per accuracy rules.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates Turkish visa application centres for many source countries. Published service/logistics fee is typically EUR 20-26 (inclusive of VAT) per application on top of the consular visa fee, but varies by centre/country - e.g. EUR 20 shown on the Czech Republic VFS page, EUR 26 cited in general search summaries. India-specific VFS fee (visa.vfsglobal.com/ind/en/tur) could not be retrieved (403 Forbidden) and was not confirmed.

free_visa_notes: Turkey is not visa-free for most nationalities but offers e-visa or visa-free entry to many countries depending on reciprocal agreements; this record does not cover visa-free eligibility, only fee schedules where a visa/e-visa is required.
